title: Dana Reyes x Justin, partner call

speaker_blocks.words: Hey Dana, thanks for making time. Quick heads up, I record my calls so I don't lose track of what we talk about. That okay?
Great. So tell me where things are at.

So most of my clients are small trucking companies and a few logistics outfits, mostly in Texas and Oklahoma. They grow in spurts, so it's usually equipment, a truck or two at a time, or working capital to cover payroll in a slow month.
What size deals are we usually talking?
Trucks run $100k to $250k, so usually around $150k.
And what got in the way of sending deals this year?
Honestly I haven't sent any because the portal changed and I didn't know who to call anymore. And it was a slow summer.
That's on us. I'm your person now, text me anytime.
My goal is to get back to two deals a month by the end of the year. I'd love to have a simple page I can put in my email signature so clients can apply without me in the middle.
We can do that. I'll set up a funnel page draft for you next week, and I'll send you the new submission link and the equipment program summary by Friday.
Perfect. Actually I have one now, Martinez Trucking needs two trucks. I'll send you the file tomorrow.
Love it. I'll watch for it.
Mornings are best to reach me, I'm on the road most afternoons.
